notes: JSON payloads are the official HDFC Sky docs samples (fetchltp, fetchCandles, profile, fetchpositionsnetwise, fetchdematholdings, fetchfundsv2, fetchpendingorder, fetchcompletedorder, tradebook, place/modify/delete regular order) with ids and prices replaced by dummies. Docs typos fixed so the samples parse: missing commas between funds rows and after contract_description. The docs do not describe the security-master columns; the CSV header is copied from the live CompactScrip.csv (October 2026) and served here as plain text (the live download is a ZIP; hdfcskyInstruments accepts both). The access token is a dummy unsigned JWT whose sub claim is the docs' DEMO1 client id. OI/volume/depth come from the WebSocket and are stubbed in hdfcsky.test.mjs.
